calculation.description: Compute 20-day momentum weighted by 10-day path efficiency, then cross-sectionally residualize the signal against contemporaneous 5-day return to remove medium-term reversal/trend exposure. Positive values indicate persistent directional momentum not explained by five-day return. All inputs use data available at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.040557), 2023-2024 (+0.029594), and 2025-2027 (+0.028193). Small 15-instrument universe; interpret uncertainty conservatively.
